evidence: The film thickness showed a linear dependency on the number of reaction cycles, and the growth rate was 0.054 nm/cycle [Fig. 2(c)]. The incubation time, which was estimated from the intercept in Fig. 2(c) with the abscissa at the origin, was only ~18 cycles. The gram density of the film, which was determined by considering the atomic areal density from the RUMP simulation and film thickness by XRR analysis, was approximately ~4.41 g/cm3, corresponding to ~89.5% of the bulk value (density of bulk TiC: 4.93 g/cm3).
